uk.title: Python для автоматизації
uk.practice: Напиши typed evaluator, що читає JSONL, генерує results поступово й закриває файл навіть після exception. Додай pytest для nested copy, invalid input і власного exception.

codeExamples.title: Typed evaluator і dataclass
codeExamples.explanation: Duplicate integers стають одним key у dict. frozen record не замінює validation; immutable frozenset тут обрано навмисно. Це validator fixture, не production authorization.

codeExamples.title: Shallow і deep copy
codeExamples.code:
from copy import copy, deepcopy

original = {"contexts": ["A"]}
shallow = copy(original)
deep = deepcopy(original)
shallow["contexts"].append("B")
assert original["contexts"] == ["A", "B"]
assert deep["contexts"] == ["A"]
codeExamples.explanation: Shallow copy ділить nested list. У test data це створює залежності між cases; deep copy теж не універсальний для sockets, clients і custom objects.

codeExamples.title: Generator і context manager
codeExamples.code:
import json
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path

@contextmanager
def jsonl_rows(path: Path):
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        yield (json.loads(line) for line in stream if line.strip())

# with jsonl_rows(Path("cases.jsonl")) as rows:
#     for row in rows:
#         print(row["case_id"])
codeExamples.explanation: Iteration має відбуватися всередині with. Після виходу file закритий; generator не слід повертати за межі scope. JSON parsing error не приховуй; schema validation додай окремо.

codeExamples.title: Decorator для вимірювання
codeExamples.explanation: finally вимірює також failed runs; wraps зберігає metadata. Це synchronous приклад; async function потребує wrapper з await. Для production telemetry не друкуй sensitive arguments.

codeExamples.title: Retrieval metrics без LLM judge
codeExamples.explanation: Тут precision використовує fixed k навіть якщо results менше; recall для no-relevant case — None. MRR — mean rr по dataset, не rr одного case. Passage-level relevance потребує інших IDs/labels.

codeExamples.title: Application validator tool calls
codeExamples.explanation: Це локальний business validator, не повна MCP implementation. Allowed orders повинні надходити з trusted identity/authorization service, не від моделі. JSON Schema і server authorization додаються окремо.

en.title: Python for automation
en.practice: Write a typed evaluator that reads JSONL, yields results lazily and closes the file even after an exception. Add pytest cases for nested copies, invalid input and a custom exception.

codeExamples.title: Typed evaluator and dataclass
codeExamples.explanation: Duplicate integers become one dictionary key. Frozen records do not replace validation; frozenset is intentional. This is a validator fixture, not production authorization.

codeExamples.title: Shallow and deep copies
codeExamples.code:
from copy import copy, deepcopy

original = {"contexts": ["A"]}
shallow = copy(original)
deep = deepcopy(original)
shallow["contexts"].append("B")
assert original["contexts"] == ["A", "B"]
assert deep["contexts"] == ["A"]
codeExamples.explanation: Shallow copies share nested lists. This can couple test cases; deep copies are not universal for sockets, clients and custom objects.

codeExamples.title: Generator and context manager
codeExamples.code:
import json
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path

@contextmanager
def jsonl_rows(path: Path):
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        yield (json.loads(line) for line in stream if line.strip())

# with jsonl_rows(Path("cases.jsonl")) as rows:
#     for row in rows:
#         print(row["case_id"])
codeExamples.explanation: Iterate inside with. The file closes after exit, so do not let the generator escape its scope. Do not hide JSON parsing errors; add separate schema validation.

codeExamples.title: A timing decorator
codeExamples.explanation: finally measures failed runs too and wraps preserves metadata. This synchronous example needs an await-based wrapper for async functions. Production telemetry must not print sensitive arguments.

codeExamples.title: Retrieval metrics without an LLM judge
codeExamples.explanation: Precision uses fixed k even if fewer results are returned; recall is None for no-relevant cases. MRR is dataset-mean rr rather than one-case rr. Passage-level relevance requires different IDs/labels.

codeExamples.title: An application tool-call validator
codeExamples.explanation: This is a local business validator, not a complete MCP implementation. Allowed orders must come from a trusted identity/authorization service rather than the model. Add JSON Schema and server authorization separately.
